title: Why Le Pen's plan for a constitutional referendum would be 'a coup d'état in form and content'
subhead: If she were to win, far-right presidential candidate Marine Le Pen has pledged to call a referendum to revise the Constitution and enshrine the far right's core principles in it. According to a member of the highest administrative court, this would be 'a double coup d'état, both in form and content.'

'The entire region was up in flames': Residents of southern Lebanon live in fear of Israeli strikes and the fires they cause
subhead: In areas under Israeli control, Lebanese firefighters require authorization to intervene to contain blazes caused by bombings. In villages that remain populated, residents feel isolated and fear they may be forced to leave their homes.

title: French government tries to defuse victims' anger over wildfires
subhead: Despite announcing emergency measures, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu faced angry victims in Gironde on Monday. In the Var, President Emmanuel Macron stressed the technical aspects of firefighting, but avoided mention of climate change.

title: Historian Vincent Lemire: 'In the West Bank, the inaction of Western governments allows violence to be unleashed'

subhead: 'Voices of Afghan Women' (2/6). Upon returning to power on August 15, 2021, the Taliban dismantled institutions, laws and services related to women's rights in a matter of days and purged the judicial system of all female presence. title: Why are heatwaves becoming more frequent in France?
subhead: Between May and July, France was the most abnormally hot country in the world, compared to its average heat index. While the role of global warming is not under debate, the frequency of this summer's heatwaves is a topic of scientific debate.

title: Tiananmen Square massacre: Le Monde reveals unseen footage of the Chinese regime's violent repression
subhead: Art historian Nathalie Trouveroy shared footage with Le Monde from her personal archives of the Tiananmen Square protests, shedding new light on how the Chinese regime violently repressed the student protests in June 1989.
